body.name: Complete observable contribution-recovery margin vector
body.construction: \(\mathfrak m(p)\) lists the two cohort shares; \(g^d\); the smallest singular values of every \(\bar A_{xy}^d\), \(B_a^d\), \(B_b^d\), \(W^d\), and \(C_y^d(C_y^d)^\top\); the absolute values of every entry of \(q_{ay}^d\), \(q_{by}^d\), and \(c^d\) used in a division; every recovered active mass \(\widehat\alpha_j^d\); and the separation of the two common untreated cycle-product signatures.  It is evaluated on the enlarged \(126\)-cell absorbing support and includes every denominator, inverse, eigengap, and label margin used by the recovery map.
